items.title: Intel Is Up 176% This Year. Is It Time to Take Profits on INTC, AMD, Broadcom, and NVIDIA?
items.summary: Intel's stunning 176% run has the semiconductor sector buzzing, but with AMD trading at a jaw-dropping 123x earnings and a fresh dilution event on the table, figuring out where to hold and where to fold across chip stocks has never been more consequential.

items.title: Why Broadcom Is The Low-Beta AI Play To Buy
items.summary: Broadcom controls two chokepoints inside every major AI cluster, and hyperscalers have already signed the contracts to prove it. The question is whether that grip justifies buying the stock today or waiting for a setup with more margin for error.
